<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Complete a BREAK_CASE task by breaking the sealed case in inventory-storage"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/tasks/{id}/case-breaks"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



A BREAK_CASE task (ADR 0054) is created when an each pick finds only a sealed case at its source. Completing it asks inventory-storage to break the container (`POST /containers/{lpn}/case-breaks`) into the loose bin, with an Idempotency-Key stable per task, and only then completes the task and publishes `TaskCompleted`. If inventory-storage cannot be reached the task stays claimed (503); a retry does not break twice.

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-supplied key, 1-128 printable ASCII characters (a UUID minted once per LOGICAL submit; a retry reuses it, a new user action mints a new one). Required on every POST: a missing key is `400 idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one `400 idempotency-key-invalid`. The key is global to the service: a retry with the same method, path and body replays the stored answer (status, body and `Location`) with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` and runs nothing; the same key with a different method, path or body is `409 idempotency-key-reused`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"pattern":"^[ -~]+$","example":"6f1c2a3e-9b1d-4c1a-8f0e-2d5b7c9a1e44"}},{"name":"id","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The task id.","schema":{"type":"string","example":"20260101T120000.000000000"}}]}
